webLinks.linkText: Road network impacts - Port of Newcastle to Central West

properties.otherAdvice:
Oversize and Overmass (OSOM) deliveries are underway. The 80-metre long wind turbine blades are being transported from the Port of Newcastle to the Uungula Wind Farm development near Wellington in the Central West Orana. Multiple OSOM movements will leave each week, although the number may vary. 

The blade components are scheduled to leave the Port at night time to minimise impacts around the Newcastle precinct. These vehicles are then expected to be travelling between Warkworth and Wellington during daylight hours.

Traffic may be held, or there may be delays at the following key locations:

  • The intersection of John Renshaw Dr and Hunter Expressway
  • Golden Hwy at Mount Thorley, Denman, Merriwa and Saxa Road
  • Mitchell Hwy onto Goolma Rd
  • Goolma Rd and Twelve Mile Rd

Motorists are urged to slow down and exercise caution when approaching or passing an OSOM load.

Eastbound: Chifley Rd and Darling Causeway.

Westbound: Harley Ave, Darling Causeway, Chifley Rd.

Allow extra travel time. If travelling during peak periods (Monday to Thursday 8:30 to 10am and 2 to 3:30pm, and Friday 8:30am to 3:30pm), you may need to allow around an additional hour of travel time. 

Through traffic on Great Western Hwy can consider alternative routes such as the Golden Hwy or Hume Hwy.

  • Detour is suitable for general access vehicles up to 19 metres long and Performance Based Standards (PBS) Level 1 heavy vehicles up to 20 metres long
  • Restricted access heavy vehicle operators who are unable to travel on an approved Notice Network are advised to reroute their journeys.
  • Restricted access heavy vehicle operators who are unable to travel on a Notice Network are advised to apply for an amended permit via NHVR Go. 
  • Please note that Class 1 Oversize and/or Over Mass (OSOM) vehicles and Special Purpose Vehicles (SPV) cannot currently be accommodated on the Chifley Rd/Darling Causeway detour route. 
  • To check approved Notice Networks, heavy vehicle operators can use the NHVR National Network Map to find an alternative route for their combination: https://www.nhvr.gov.au/road-access/route-planner/national-network-map

Operators who require a NHVR issued Permit are reminded that they must only travel on the roads approved in their Permit.

arrangementElements.html:
A full closure will be in place from Monday 2 November until Wednesday 11 November.

When this closure is in place heavy vehicles to divert via Wombat Rd and Burley Griffin Way in both directions. This detour is suitable for B-doubles and PBS 2A vehicles up to 26 metres, and will add about 10 minutes' travel time to most journeys. 

PBS 2B permit vehicles and those longer than 26 metres and up to 30 metres in length will be detoured as follows:

Southbound: at Cowra via Lachlan Valley Way, Hume Highway, Burley Griffin Way and rejoin the Olympic Highway at Wallendbeen.

Northbound: at Wallendeen via Burley Griffin Way, Hume Highway, Lachlan Valley Way and rejoin the Olympic Highway at Cowra.

This detour will add more than one hour to travel times. 

 

Please note:

Unless specified otherwise, operators of Class 1,2 & 3 vehicles travelling under a Notice must consult their relevant enforceable network map to confirm a suitable approved alternate route. 

Operators of Class 1, 2 & 3 vehicles travelling under a Permit must not travel off the approved route listed in the permit unless an updated permit is obtained from the NHVR.
